title: Every semi-normalized unconditional Schauder frame in Hilbert spaces contains a frame
summary: Let $H$ be an infinite-dimensional Hilbert space. We prove that every unconditional Schauder frame for $H$ contains a subsequence that can be normalized to form a frame for $H$.
